name: claude-code-security-plugins
description: Automated security scanning (Bandit, Semgrep, Trivy, TruffleHog, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner, mcp-scan, mcp-exfil-scan, skillspector) with an APTS-aligned structured report. Shares one source tree with the Claude Code plugin.

interface.longDescription: Runs Gitleaks, Bandit, Semgrep, Trivy, TruffleHog, OSV-Scanner and Claude/MCP/skill audits against a codebase and assembles one OWASP APTS-aligned markdown report. The security-scanner skill and its bundled scripts are identical to the Claude Code plugin; guardrail hooks install separately to ~/.codex/hooks.json (see codex/install-codex-hooks.sh).
interface.defaultPrompt: Run a security scan of this codebase.
